paragraphs.text: DSH leader/worker orchestration bundle: project tree, delivery board, worker sessions
English | 简体中文
# dsh-leader-agent
> One Leader drives the work and the review, so you can run ten features in parallel instead of baby

sitting each one.
>
> A leader / worker orchestration bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). The Leader
splits work, dispatches it, tracks every worker to completion, checks what comes back and runs revie
w; workers do the work in the background, report back automatically, and every task fact lands on a
board organized by project. Running one worktree per task is this repository's convention, not a req
uirement of the bundle.
## Highlights
1. **One Leader drives development and review** — You state the goal once. The Leader opens cards, d
ispatches workers, watches each one finish, verifies the deliverable and organizes review. Your atte
ntion goes back to "what do I want" instead of "which agent is stuck"; the target is ten features in

flight at once.
2. **A right SidePanel board: see who is working at a glance** — One board per proj
ect. Each card carries its executor slot and a live status light, its note renders as Markdown, and
its links are editable in place. Click a card for the spec (goal, scope, acceptance, links), click a
slot to drill into that agent's session and keep talking; worker reports arrive as the worker speak

ing, also Markdown-rendered.
3. **Arrange your agents however you want** — Two files do the arrangin
g. `LEADER.md` holds the Leader's prompt and this project's orchestration rules: boundaries, dispatc
h requirements, acceptance criteria. `SLOTS.md` gives each worker role its own rules (dev / review /
…). Both are evaluated before every model request and appended only when their text changes, so edi

ting a file changes behavior without recreating sessions.
4. **Many projects in parallel, one Leader
each** — Adding a project binds a leader session to it, and the project tree lists the workers that
Leader spawned; rows can be dragged to reorder, and deleting a project only drops the record while
keeping the folder and the sessions (dsh workspaces are untouched). Projects stay out of each other'
s way. Swap in a new Leader and the existing workers plus undelivered reports move over, so it can d

ispatch immediately.
5. **The `leader-mode` skill: an orchestration protocol for the Leader** — Not
"you are a tech lead". Staged playbooks across discussion → design → implementation and delivery → r

eview → merge, plus guidance on parallel collaboration and handoff.
[该节后续省略]
## Install
### Desktop install (DeepSeek Harness Desktop)
Desktop uses its own profile (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`), separate from `web`.
**GUI install:** open **Plugins** in the left sidebar, click **Add plugin** in the top right, type `
dsh-leader-agent` and click **Install**:
**CLI install:** the system `dsh` refuses to manage the desktop profile; use the CLI bundled with th
he system `dsh` refuses to manage the desktop profile; use the CLI bundled with the desktop install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
On Windows / Linux, use `runtime/cli/bin/dsh` inside the installation directory. The app reads the p
rofile only at startup, and only one version can be mounted at a time. `DSH_HOME` must be absolute o
r start with `~/`. Sessions, projects, and cards are shared with `web`; plugin packages and activati
`. Sessions, projects, and cards are shared with `web`; plugin packages and activation are separate.
For development inside this repository, `npm run desktop` mounts the current worktree, rebuilds the
bundle and launches the app; `-- --remove` unmounts it.
### Web install
Install from npm (package name `dsh-leader-agent`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The profile must be named `web`; custom names are absent from `PROFILE_TEMPLATES`, so the install la
cks the web-app bundle and the client half never loads. Requires dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`.
[该节后续省略]
## Prerequisites: get multi-worktree parallelism working first
Running ten features in parallel requires real isolation between tasks: one worktree per task, one d
sh instance per task, one data root per task, so tasks never overwrite each other's plugin version o
r compete for sessions and data. This repository's `scripts/worktree-*.mjs` and `scripts/dev.mjs` ex
ist for exactly this (Development); mechanisms and where each one lands are in collaboration and doc
umentation (Chinese).
## Current limitations
- **Background orchestration needs a long-lived host** (web / desktop / sdk). headless is a one-shot
CLI: the session is destroyed when the turn ends, and nothing is left to receive completion reports

.
- **The Leader cannot stop a worker.** Workers are ordinary root sessions, so the host's `list_age
nts` / `send_message` / `interrupt_agent` do not apply to them (`interrupt_agent` even returns a fal
se success). A worker that goes off track has to be handled by a human in its own session. That is t
he price of persistence. You can read what it is doing (`read_worker_session`, read-only, no wake-up

), but you cannot act for it or call it off.
- **Completion reports depend on the turn ending normal
ly.** If the process dies before a worker finishes, that turn is never settled. After a restart, ope

n the worker session and continue there.
- **The board only shows for project sessions.** The leader
and that project's workers see it; an ordinary session in the same directory, or a retired leader,

only gets a notice, and sessions outside any project get no board at all.
- **Card details only writ
e links.** Links can be added, edited and removed in the detail panel; completing, pinning, renaming
and deleting still belong to the Leader's card tools. Card numbers increase globally and are never

reused or reclaimed across projects.
- **The project registry is only reachable from the left sideba
r.** There are no project tools for the model; if the directory picker is unavailable you cannot cre

ate a project and need the web profile.
- **The project tree coexists with the official workspace tr
ee.** Projects neither register nor occupy dsh workspaces: project sessions land in the official tre
e's "Ungrouped" section and are excluded there at render time (official counts and search still incl

ude them); when nothing but excluded rows is left in that section, its header is hidden too.
